title: Two PhD paths in metabolic research at CIPF
title_zh: CIPF 代谢研究的两个博士项目
summary: Toni shared two Valencia-based PhD projects spanning healthy adipose expansion and lipotoxicity, with support to prepare an FPU application.
summary_zh: Toni 分享了 Valencia 的两个博士研究方向，涵盖健康脂肪扩增与脂毒性，并提供 FPU 申请指导。
body: The projects are hosted by the healthy white adipose tissue expansion group (I-76) and the lipotoxicity and fatty liver disease group (I-81). Training spans cellular models, metabolic phenotyping, multi-omics and microfluidic 3D culture. Interested graduates can contact Stefania Carobbio or Antonio Vidal-Puig through the original announcement for current eligibility and application details.
body_zh: 两个项目分别由白色脂肪组织健康扩增团队（I-76）和脂毒性与脂肪肝团队（I-81）开展。培训涵盖细胞模型、代谢表型、多组学及微流控三维培养。有意申请的毕业生可通过原帖联系 Stefania Carobbio 或 Antonio Vidal-Puig，核实申请资格与最新安排。

title: Exploring a research career at CIPF
title_zh: 在 CIPF 探索科研职业道路

body: Toni highlighted the value of meeting researchers, asking questions and learning how scientific careers develop. CIPF’s event is announced for 25 September 2026 at 16:30 in Valencia, covering research opportunities across metabolic disease, cancer, neuroscience, computational biology and data science. Please check the original announcement for attendance details.
body_zh: Toni 强调，与科研人员交流、提问并了解真实的科研生活，是职业探索的重要一步。CIPF 活动定于 2026 年 9 月 25 日 16:30 在 Valencia 举行，涉及代谢疾病、癌症、神经科学、计算生物学及数据科学。参加方式请以原始通知为准。

title: EDC-MASLD: a new study of PFAS and liver metabolism
title_zh: EDC-MASLD：PFAS 与肝脏代谢新研究

summary_zh: Toni 分享发表于 Environment International 的合作研究，探讨 PFAS 暴露、肠道微生物代谢物与肝脏代谢的关系。
body: The EDC-MASLD pilot study examines changes in microbial metabolites associated with hepatic metabolism. Authors include Antonio Vidal-Puig and Stefania Carobbio alongside international collaborators. The update links to the project’s announcement and the paper; it describes research findings, rather than a clinical treatment recommendation.
body_zh: 这项 EDC-MASLD 试点研究考察与肝脏代谢相关的微生物代谢物变化。作者包括 Antonio Vidal-Puig、Stefania Carobbio 及国际合作伙伴。可通过原始动态查看项目介绍与论文链接。

body: The seminar was scheduled for 2 September 2026 at 14:00 in Level 4 Seminar Rooms 1 and 2 at the Institute of Metabolic Science. title: Speaking on Obesity and Health Equity at the House of Lords
title_zh: 上议院：肥胖与健康公平
summary: Toni joined a House of Lords panel on culturally aware, evidence-based obesity care and health equity.
summary_zh: Toni 受邀参加英国上议院专家讨论，探讨兼顾文化背景、科学证据与健康公平的肥胖照护。
body: This week marked a significant and memorable milestone, as Professor Toni-Vidal Puig was invited to speak at the House of Lords as a guest of Baroness Manzila Uddin, in partnership with the Global Muslim Weight Management Group. Being asked to contribute to an expert panel within such a historic setting was both an honour and a humbling experience.

What stood out most during the discussion was the shared sense of purpose in the room. Clinicians, scientists, community leaders, and policy voices came together around a clear and powerful principle: obesity care is most effective when it is culturally and faith-aware, while remaining firmly grounded in scientific evidence. The seriousness and mutual respect among participants underscored the importance of collaboration across disciplines and communities.
Why this matters

Obesity and its cardiometabolic complications represent a growing public health challenge across Muslim communities in the UK and globally. This issue is particularly pressing in South Asian Muslim populations, where the risks of type 2 diabetes and cardiovascular disease often emerge at lower body weight and are strongly influenced by visceral fat and metabolic factors.

These concerns closely align with Professor Puig’s own research focus, which emphasises that health risk is not simply a matter of “how much” weight is carried, but where fat is stored, how metabolism adapts, and how biological processes interact with environment, culture, and lived experience. Being invited by the community on the basis that this research is relevant and meaningful was described as genuinely humbling.
A programme with ambition and integrity

The initiative itself left a strong impression. The ethical leadership, the calibre of professionals involved, and the programme’s emphasis on women and children stood out as particular strengths. By focusing on prevention, education, and sustained support early in life, the work has the potential to influence health outcomes across the entire life course.

While the programme is rooted in the UK, its ambition clearly extends further. The aim is not only to improve care within Muslim communities globally, but also to generate learning that can inform broader approaches to public health. Principles such as trust, culturally tailored education, community-based support, and inclusive research are widely applicable and could act as a catalyst for faith-sensitive and community-centred health partnerships far beyond any single group.
A personal commitment

Although not Muslim himself, Professor Puig has expressed a deep commitment to wellbeing, fairness, and equitable health outcomes. His role within this initiative will be to support its development with scientific rigour, helping to ensure that guidance remains evidence-based, credible, and responsive to emerging data. Equally important is the opportunity to learn from the community itself, strengthening the ability of research and practice to serve people better over time.

Gratitude was extended to everyone involved, with special thanks to Nathan Nagel for his leadership of the project, and to Husna Ahmad for closing the discussion with clarity and compassion, highlighting the central role of empathy, community, and timely treatment in addressing obesity and related health challenges.
body_zh: 此次活动由 Manzila Uddin 女男爵邀请，并与 Global Muslim Weight Management Group 合作举办。临床医生、科研人员、社区代表与政策界人士共同讨论：如何让肥胖预防与治疗更贴近不同群体的文化、信仰及生活经验。
讨论特别关注英国及全球穆斯林群体的心脏代谢健康，以及南亚人群在较低体重下仍可能面临的糖尿病和心血管风险。这与 TVPlab 对脂肪分布、代谢适应和环境相互作用的研究密切相关。
该倡议强调妇女儿童健康、生命早期预防、教育与长期支持。Toni 将以科研专长支持项目发展，同时向社区学习，推动以证据为基础、以信任和同理心为支撑的健康服务。原文特别感谢 Nathan Nagel 和 Husna Ahmad 的贡献。

title: Toni joins the Scientific Advisory Board of Argonaute RNA Ltd
title_zh: Toni 加入 Argonaute RNA 科学顾问委员会
summary: Toni joined the Scientific Advisory Board of Argonaute RNA, connecting metabolic research with RNA therapeutics development.
summary_zh: Toni 加入 Argonaute RNA 科学顾问委员会，将代谢研究专长与 RNA 疗法开发相结合。
body: We are delighted to announce that Prof. Antonio Vidal-Puig has accepted an appointment to the Scientific Advisory Board of Argonaute RNA Ltd , a pioneering biotech company based in Cardiff, Wales, focused on next-generation RNA interference (RNAi) therapies for cardiometabolic and other high-unmet-need diseases.
Argonaute RNA is developing innovative gene-silencing therapeutics based on two proprietary platforms:

PULSE siRNA™ : A stabilised small interfering RNA (siRNA) platform designed for acute indications where a short duration of target gene knock-down is critical. The company emphasises “ideal peak knock-down → rapid recovery” profiles enabled without heavy chemical modification. Argo Dual siRNA : A bispecific siRNA chemistry combining two gene-silencing agents into a single molecule, aimed at complex, multi-factorial diseases (e.g., cardiometabolic disorders) where silencing a single gene may not suffice. The platform leverages DNA-nanotechnology style design and manufacturing cost-advantages.

Argonaute RNA’s broader mission is to harness RNAi, a cell-mechanism that inhibits the expression of specific genes, thereby modulating protein production and disease pathways. Their proprietary method of siRNA stabilisation helps overcome historic obstacles in siRNA drug development for human use.
body_zh: 位于威尔士 Cardiff 的 Argonaute RNA 专注于下一代 RNA 干扰疗法，面向心脏代谢疾病等医疗需求尚未得到充分满足的领域。
原文介绍了公司的 PULSE siRNA™ 平台，以及将两种基因沉默机制结合于单一分子的 Argo Dual siRNA 技术。Toni 的加入为公司的科学顾问团队带来肥胖、脂毒性及代谢疾病研究经验。

title: Season's Greetings from TVPLab!
title_zh: TVPlab 的节日祝福
summary: The lab reflected on a year of teamwork, welcomed new colleagues and looked ahead to 2025.
summary_zh: 实验室回顾一年的共同努力，欢迎新成员，并展望 2025 年的合作与探索。
body: As the year draws to a close, we reflect with gratitude on the incredible journey we've shared in the TVPLab. This holiday season, we embrace the new horizons ahead as our lab continues to grow and expand, welcoming new members to our ever-evolving team. We are excited to foster new ideas, deepen our collaborations, and push the boundaries of our research.

To our dedicated long-standing members, thank you for your unwavering commitment, passion, and brilliance. Your hard work has been the cornerstone of our success, and we look forward to achieving even greater milestones together in the coming year.

To the new faces joining us, we extend a warm welcome! Your fresh perspectives and enthusiasm will add to the vibrancy of our group, and we are excited to see the impact you'll have as we continue our mission to uncover the biological mechanisms that will transform the future of obesity and metabolic disease treatments.

We wish all our team members, past and present, a joyful and peaceful holiday season filled with rest, renewal, and time with loved ones. May the new year bring exciting opportunities, breakthroughs, and continued success for each of us—both within and beyond the lab.
Here’s to a bright and transformative 2025!
Warmest wishes,
The TVPLab Team
body_zh: TVPlab 感谢长期成员的投入与贡献，也欢迎新同事带来的观点与热情。团队期待继续深化合作，研究肥胖和代谢疾病的生物学机制。
祝愿所有现任及往届成员度过平安愉快的假期，在休息与陪伴家人中恢复精力，并在新的一年迎来新的成长与成果。

visiting the Cambridge University Nanjing Centre for Technology and Innovation. This is part of our programme of research  "Comprehensive Life Course

title: Lund University Diabetes Centre
title_zh: 隆德大学糖尿病中心交流
summary: Toni reflected on diabetes research, faculty development and shared leadership after visiting the LUDC retreat.
summary_zh: Toni 参加隆德大学糖尿病中心年度研讨会，交流糖尿病研究、人才培养与共同领导经验。
body: I was honoured to be invited to the annual LUDC (Lund University Diabetes Centre) annual retreat in Helsingborg, invited by my host Prof Philipp Kaldis. I enjoyed the presentations of a competitive and unique research programme focused on diabetes. I think this is one of the few examples in Europe of a centre focused on whole aspects of Diabetes, ranging from clinical research to cutting-edge basic research. An essential part of their success is their strategy of recruiting and developing their faculty, inspired by a research culture where strong laboratories support the development and consolidation of emerging laboratories. Also, the management structure benefits from an inclusive shared leadership coordinated by Prof Gomez and supported by four vice-coordinators that promote the development of emergent leadership. This is a place where access to competitive funding makes an excellent environment to do competitive research.
body_zh: 应 Philipp Kaldis 教授邀请，Toni 前往 Helsingborg 参加 LUDC 年度研讨会。中心将临床研究与前沿基础研究紧密结合，其学术文化鼓励成熟团队支持新兴实验室发展。
Toni 特别关注该中心的人才引进与培养策略，以及由协调负责人和四位副协调人共同推进的管理模式。这些经验为建设有竞争力、支持青年人才成长的科研环境提供了启发。

title: Our cardiometabolic laboratory opens at HLRI
title_zh: TVPlab 心脏代谢实验室在 HLRI 启用
summary: A new HLRI laboratory brought metabolic research closer to cardiovascular and clinical collaborators.
summary_zh: TVPlab 在剑桥心肺研究所（HLRI）启用心脏代谢实验室，进一步连接代谢、心血管与临床研究。
body: We chose the hottest day of the decade to open up our cardiometabolic lab at the new Cambridge Heart Lung Research Institute (HLRI). This is a great opportunity to innovate through colocalisation with our colleagues from the cardiovascular department as well as our colleagues from Papworth Hospital. This is part of our strategy to capture the strengths of the Institute of Metabolic Science and the HLRI in obesity, diabetes and associated cardiovascular complications by bringing together a critical mass of researchers with expertise in the domain of cardiometabolic research, one of the key themes of the BHF Centre of Excellence in Cambridge. For the TVPLab is a bit of overstretching but worth it given the potential for innovation and competitiveness. Here with my colleague Sonia Rodriguez Fernandez who is leading our efforts at HLRI. In the next few days.....another picture with the other scientists embracing the cardiometabolic theme....... please no comments about the shorts.....today we were at 40C ....
body_zh: 新实验室与心血管研究同事及 Papworth Hospital 团队共处同一科研环境，有助于结合 IMS 和 HLRI 在肥胖、糖尿病及相关心血管并发症方面的优势。
Sonia Rodriguez Fernandez 负责推动 TVPlab 在 HLRI 的工作。该布局也呼应剑桥 BHF 卓越中心的心脏代谢研究主题。
originalTitle: Our cardiometabolic lab at the new Cambridge Heart Lung Research Institute (HLRI) is open!!!

title: Congratulations to Adrian Yu-Hung Lin on passing his PhD viva
title_zh: 祝贺 Adrian Yu-Hung Lin 通过博士答辩
summary: Adrian completed his PhD investigating THADA and energy metabolism, and returned to Taiwan to develop his research career.
summary_zh: Adrian 完成了关于 THADA 与能量代谢的博士研究，并返回台湾继续发展科研事业。
body: Our colleague Yu-Hung Li (Adrian) obtained his PhD on Monday. His research investigated the role of THADA (thyroid adenoma-associated protein) on energy metabolism. He was examined by Prof Antonio Zorzano and Dr Andrew Murray, and supervised by my colleague Dr Sergio Rodriguez Cuenca.

Adrian was a unique student, very mature, and already trained as a surgeon in liver transplantation and bariatric surgery in Taiwan. He came to Cambridge determined to do basic research on a challenging project at a challenging time. He came with his wife and two children. His PhD was interrupted due to a serious family problem, and he went back to Taiwan. I honestly thought he would not be able to come back, but six months later he was back in the lab. He was very resilient, focused and nicely humble, and has inspired our lab by showing that you can accomplish something when you are passionate about it. He is one of these guys that genuinely we are all happy and proud of his accomplishment. Adrian is now back in Taiwan where he is opening his lab. We wish him luck and from here we offer him our support to launch his career there.
Thanks very much for your brilliant contribution to the TVPLab
body_zh: Adrian 的研究由 Sergio Rodriguez Cuenca 博士指导，Antonio Zorzano 教授和 Andrew Murray 博士担任答辩考官。作为具备肝移植和减重手术临床经验的外科医生，他来到剑桥开展基础研究。
团队赞赏他在困难中坚持研究的韧性与专注，感谢他的贡献，并祝愿他在台湾建立实验室、开启新的事业阶段。

title: EDIW Summer party 2022
title_zh: EDIW 夏日聚会 2022
summary: Colleagues and families gathered in the gardens of Anstey Hall for the departmental summer party.
summary_zh: 同事与家人在 Anstey Hall 花园相聚，参加部门夏日聚会。
body: The EDIW summer party took place on 30th June . It was a fantastic opportunity for the whole department to come together and enjoy pizza, prosecco and a lot of ice cream, on a (mostly) sunny afternoon. The event was held in the beautiful gardens of Anstey Hall, Trumpington - a huge thank you to our host, John de Bruyne. Everyone had a great time and the chance for people to bring their partners and children (with wide open spaces for the kids to run around in) gave it a real family-feel. We look forward to seeing you all at our next event!
body_zh: 6 月 30 日的 EDIW 活动为大家提供了放松交流的机会，有披萨、冰淇淋和适合孩子们玩耍的户外空间。感谢 John de Bruyne 提供场地，也期待下一次相聚。

title: Toni appointed Visiting Professor at Chiba University
title_zh: Toni 获聘千叶大学客座教授
summary: Chiba University awarded Toni a Visiting Professorship, building on existing scientific collaborations.
summary_zh: 日本千叶大学聘任 Toni 为客座教授，进一步延续双方已有的科研合作。
body: Chiba University in Japan has awarded Professor Toni Vidal-Puig a Visiting Professorship. Toni has strong links with Chiba through his ongoing scientific collaborations with Professor Miki and Professor Bujo.
body_zh: Toni 与千叶大学 Miki 教授和 Bujo 教授保持着长期科学合作，此次聘任进一步巩固了双方的学术联系。

title: Jennie passes her PhD viva without corrections
title_zh: Jennie 博士答辩获无修改通过
summary: Jennie passed her PhD viva without corrections after research linking fatty liver and diastolic heart failure.
summary_zh: Jennie 围绕脂肪肝与舒张性心力衰竭的博士研究，获得答辩无修改通过。
body: Jennie Leggat is now Dr Leggat. She just defended her PhD with no corrections. She now knows everything about the link between fatty liver and diastolic heart failure. Drama until the last moment when she messaged at 6 a.m. saying she was sick with something that looked like covid. She managed to still do it despite the fact she was not doing great. I am very thankful to Professors Mark Kearney and Christi Deaton for examining Jennie fully masked and at opposite sides of the room… Jennie’s PhD was challenging, she was bridging two fields, but she succeeded in working closely within the TVPLab led by Guillaume Bidault, with our cardiometabolic colleagues from the Cambridge LHRI institute, Thomas Krieg, Ana Vujic, Amy Ko, Hiran Prag and our partner Roger Foo from the National University of Singapore. Thanks to all for their engagement and support. I feel happy and relieved that after a few hard years of hardship, Jennie is ready to start the next step
body_zh: Mark Kearney 和 Christi Deaton 教授担任考官。Jennie 的跨领域研究由 Guillaume Bidault 带领的 TVPlab 团队，与 Thomas Krieg、Ana Vujic、Amy Ko、Hiran Prag 及新加坡国立大学 Roger Foo 等合作者共同支持。
团队感谢所有参与者的帮助，并祝贺 Jennie 开启职业发展的下一阶段。
originalTitle: Congratulations Jennie on passing your PhD viva, without corrections!! We are very proud of you!!

title: TVPLab integrated research unit with Centro de Investigacion Principe Felipe in Valencia
title_zh: CIPF 与剑桥建立联合研究单元
summary: CIPF and Cambridge agreed to build a Valencia-based research unit addressing obesity, diabetes and related complications.
summary_zh: CIPF 与剑桥合作，在 Valencia 建立研究单元，研究肥胖、糖尿病及相关并发症。
body: CIPF and Cambridge agreed to build a Valencia-based research unit addressing obesity, diabetes and related complications.

The original report names Deborah Burks and Antonio Vidal-Puig as principal investigators and describes the recruitment of Luke Noon and Stefania Carobbio through the Generalitat Valenciana’s GenT programme. This is a short paraphrase of the report linked below.
body_zh: 联合研究单元设于菲利佩王子研究中心（CIPF），原报道列出 Deborah Burks 和 Antonio Vidal-Puig 为项目负责人。合作旨在推进基础研究、吸引国际人才，并扩大代谢疾病研究的影响。
Luke Noon 和 Stefania Carobbio 通过瓦伦西亚自治区 GenT 计划加入 CIPF。本页为原报道的简要重述；完整报道可通过原文链接阅读。

title: Eukariotes of Fire run for East Anglian Air Ambulance
title_zh: “Eukariotes of Fire”参加慈善接力赛
summary: The lab’s Chariots of Fire team ran in support of East Anglian Air Ambulance and community CPR training.
summary_zh: 实验室团队参加 Chariots of Fire 慈善接力赛，支持 East Anglian Air Ambulance 与社区心肺复苏培训。
body: On Sunday researchers from the TVP lab took part in Chariots of Fire 2021 in aid of East Anglian Air Ambulance. Chariots of Fire is one of Cambridgeshire's largest annual charity events. Our team ran to raise money in support of EAAA to provide bystander CPR training to lower income communities across Cambridgeshire. Guillaume Bidault, Rita Dias, Adrian Lin, Eun Young Lee, Mark Campbell, along with TVP lab alumna Laura Mele all took part. They all did an amazing job and we're very proud of them!
body_zh: 参赛成员包括 Guillaume Bidault、Rita Dias、Adrian Lin、Eun Young Lee、Mark Campbell，以及实验室往届成员 Laura Mele。大家通过奔跑支持剑桥郡低收入社区的急救培训，团队为他们感到骄傲。
originalTitle: Congrats to the @TVPLab  Lab team aka "Eukariotes of Fire" who ran the #ChariotsofFire

title: First party of 2021
title_zh: 2021 年的第一次聚会
summary: Colleagues reunited in person at an Equality, Diversity, Inclusion and Well-being event.
summary_zh: 同事们在平等、多元、包容与身心健康委员会组织的活动中重聚。
body: @MRL_Cam
Equality, Diversity, Inclusion and Well-being committee thank you for a lovely evening. We had a great time :)
It was our first chance to see many of our colleagues in the flesh since March 2020!
body_zh: 这是自 2020 年 3 月以来，大家首次有机会与许多同事面对面交流。感谢 IMS-MRL 的 EDIW 委员会安排这个愉快的夜晚。

title: Sonia awarded a Sir Henry Wellcome Postdoctoral Fellowship
title_zh: Sonia 获 Sir Henry Wellcome 博士后奖学金
summary: Sonia Rodriguez Fernandez received a Sir Henry Wellcome Postdoctoral Fellowship to study human brown fat stem cells.
summary_zh: Sonia Rodriguez Fernandez 获得 Sir Henry Wellcome 博士后奖学金，研究人类棕色脂肪干细胞。
body: Sonia Rodriguez Fernandez

who has been awarded a very competitive, Sir Henry Wellcome Postdoctoral Fellowship, to work on human brown fat stem cell biology in our laboratory.  Sonia is an excellent postdoc, trained in the laboratory of Xosé R. Bustelo, in Spain, with a strong background in signalling, and we hope to help her to develop all her potential in our laboratory.
body_zh: Sonia 曾在西班牙 Xosé R. Bustelo 实验室接受训练，具备扎实的细胞信号研究背景。TVPlab 期待支持她发挥潜力，推进新的科研项目。

title: Jennie wins a poster prize at the BHF CRE symposium
title_zh: 祝贺 Jennie 获海报奖
summary: Jennie won a poster prize at the 2021 BHF CRE Cambridge Cardiovascular Symposium.
summary_zh: Jennie 在 2021 年 BHF CRE 剑桥心血管研讨会上获得海报奖。
body: Congratulation to Jennie Leggat for winning the poster prize on Annual BHF CRE Cambridge Cardiovascular symposium 2021
body_zh: 团队祝贺 Jennie Leggat 的研究展示获得认可。

title: TVPLab Christmas Party 2020
title_zh: TVPlab 线上圣诞聚会 2020
summary: The team celebrated Christmas on Zoom during a year of disrupted laboratory work and distancing measures.
summary_zh: 在实验受限、需要保持社交距离的一年，团队通过 Zoom 庆祝圣诞节。
body: This year has been really weird for lots of reasons. Our lab work ground to a halt during the first lockdown brought on by COVID-19, and since our work has resumed we have had limited capacity in the lab, and we have had to maintain strict social distancing, adhere to capacity limits in different rooms, and wear masks throughout the hospital and labs. However, we weren't going to let this stop us from having a Christmas party! On Tuesday December 15th, the TVPLab gathered on Zoom in Christmas hats and jumpers to have some coffee/hot chocolate together! A few of us then joined the IMS Christmas events, such as wreath making and the 'Midwinter Cabaret' (not as racy as it sounds...!). It was definitely very different to our normal parties, but lovely nonetheless! We hope we will be able to get together in person in the New Year.
body_zh: 12 月 15 日，大家戴上圣诞帽、穿上节日毛衣，一边喝咖啡或热巧克力，一边在线相聚。部分成员还参加了 IMS 的花环制作与 Midwinter Cabaret 活动。虽然形式不同，团队依然珍惜共同庆祝的时光，并期待新年能再次见面。

title: I'm a Scientist - Get Me Out of Here!
title_zh: “I’m a Scientist”线上科普
summary: Sonia and Jennie answered schoolchildren’s questions through an MRC-supported online science programme.
summary_zh: Sonia 与 Jennie 参加 MRC 支持的线上科普项目，回答中小学生的科学问题。
body: During the lockdown, two members of the TVP Lab - Sonia & Jennie - took part in the MRC initiative 'I'm a Scientist - Stay at Home!'. This programme was established to allow school children to talk to real scientists during their virtual science lessons in the summer term, to find out more about the subjects they were interested in! Sonia was in the 'Disease Detectives Zone', while Jennie was in the 'Medical Research Zone'. They both had a lot of fun, and were amazed by how insightful the questions they received were!
body_zh: 在疫情封锁期间，两人分别参与 Disease Detectives Zone 和 Medical Research Zone，让学生在远程科学课上接触真实科研工作。她们很享受这些交流，也对孩子们提出的问题印象深刻。

title: TVPLab are back at the bench!
title_zh: TVPlab 重返实验台
summary: The lab resumed research after the IMS reopened with measures to support safe working during the pandemic.
summary_zh: IMS 重新开放并落实疫情期间安全工作措施后，TVPlab 恢复实验研究。
body: When the coronavirus pandemic hit the UK, the IMS shutdown in accordance with government guidelines, and the TVPLab began working from home. However, thanks to the hard work and dedication of the administrative team and some key volunteers in the Institute, the IMS has reopened as a COVID-safe environment for us to be able to safely continue performing our crucial research. We cannot thank the IMS volunteer team enough for making this possible, and we're very excited to be back! Watch this space for more cutting edge research from the lab.
body_zh: 团队感谢行政人员和志愿者的努力，使实验室能够重新开展研究。经历居家工作阶段后，大家很高兴回到实验台，继续推进科研项目。

title: We climbed Everest... twice!!
title_zh: 我们在家“登顶珠峰”两次
summary: Sixteen lab members climbed 17,500 metres on their stairs to support the 4CPPE campaign.
summary_zh: 16 位实验室成员在家中楼梯累计攀爬 17,500 米，支持 4CPPE 防护物资筹款。
body: Members of the TVPLab getting ready for their epic climb to the summit of Everest,

On Monday May 18th, 16 members of the TVPLab set out on an epic adventure to climb Everest within their own homes over 5 days. The aim was to get to the summit in order to raise money for the 4CPPE Campaign . However, by the end of day 3, they had already exceeded the summit! But they kept going, and ended up climbing 17,500 m - that's TWICE the height of Everest, or the height of the tallest non-volcanic mountain in our Solar System, Boosaule Montes. Well done team! You can still donate to the cause here , and you can watch some of the team climbing below:
body_zh: 挑战于 5 月 18 日开始，原计划用五天攀登相当于珠穆朗玛峰的高度。团队第三天便超过目标，最终总高度约为珠峰的两倍。筹款旨在帮助疫情中的一线医护人员获得个人防护物资。

title: TVPLab climb Mount Everest!
title_zh: TVPlab 发起居家珠峰挑战
summary: The team planned a stair-climbing challenge to raise funds for frontline healthcare workers through 4CPPE.
summary_zh: 团队发起楼梯攀爬挑战，通过 4CPPE 为一线医护人员筹集防护物资资金。
body: Throughout the week commencing Monday 18th May 2020, members of the TVPLab will be climbing Mount Everest! ... Not the real Mount Everest because that would be socially irresponsible (#stayhomesavelives), but we are all coming together to climb 8,848 metres on our stairs! We're doing this to raise money for the 4CPPE Appeal in order to keep our frontline workers safe in the continuing COVID-19 crisis. Please consider donating to the cause here.
body_zh: 从 2020 年 5 月 18 日开始，成员们计划在各自家中累计攀爬 8,848 米，以居家运动的方式支持疫情期间的医护工作。

title: 4CPPE Appeal
title_zh: 4CPPE 防护物资倡议
summary: Toni and collaborators worked across China and the UK to support access to protective equipment for NHS staff.
summary_zh: Toni 与中英合作者共同推动防护物资供应，支持英国 NHS 一线医护人员。
body: In the midst of the COVID-19 pandemic, Prof. Vidal-Puig and his collaborators are doing their bit to ensure the safety and protection of our vital frontline healthcare workers. By liaising with collaborators in Nanjing, China, to source and bring in PPE whilst working with UK companies to design respirators, the aim of the 4CPPE Campaign is to ensure that plenty of personal protective equipment (PPE) - such as masks, goggles, gowns and gloves - is available in the UK to protect our NHS staff so that they continue to focus on what they do best - caring for patients. To achieve this, the 4CPPE Team are seeking support from the public in the form of donations. Please consider donating to this vital appeal - every little helps! You can donate here , or you can visit the website to find out more. We thank you for your generosity in this challenging time.
body_zh: 团队与南京伙伴联系采购物资，同时与英国企业合作推进呼吸防护设备设计。4CPPE 倡议通过公众支持，为医护人员争取口罩、护目镜、防护服和手套等装备。此处保留的是 2020 年历史报道。

title: Cambridge Half Marathon for the British Heart Foundation
title_zh: 剑桥半程马拉松支持英国心脏基金会
summary: Four lab members completed the Cambridge Half Marathon and raised £185 for the British Heart Foundation.
summary_zh: 四位实验室成员完成剑桥半程马拉松，为英国心脏基金会筹得 185 英镑。
body: TVP lab members after their race.

On Sunday March 8th 2020, 4 members of the TVP lab (Floris Honig, Guillaume Bidault, Isabella Samuelson & Mark Campbell) ran the Cambridge Half Marathon to raise money for the British Heart Foundation. They did an great job, raising £185 for the BHF and smashing PBs in the process!
body_zh: 2020 年 3 月 8 日，Floris Honig、Guillaume Bidault、Isabella Samuelson 和 Mark Campbell 参加比赛，在筹款的同时刷新个人最好成绩。祝贺大家！

title: Getting the word out about our research
title_zh: 让更多人了解我们的研究
summary: Sam Virtue shared the lab’s science through educational videos and The Naked Scientists.
summary_zh: Sam Virtue 通过教育视频与 The Naked Scientists 平台，向更多人介绍实验室研究。
body: Dr. Virtue and his glamorous assistant.

TVP lab Senior Research Associate, Dr. Sam Virtue, has been hard at work disseminating our work to fellow scientists and the wider public. He has appeared in Cambridge University Press Education Youtube videos such as this one to teach the public about obesity and diabetes, and is a regular in The Naked Scientists podcasts and articles . Keep it up, Sam!
body_zh: 作为 TVPlab 高级研究人员，Sam 参与 Cambridge University Press Education 的视频制作，讲解肥胖和糖尿病，并通过播客及文章向科研同行与公众传播科学知识。

title: Public engagement at the Suffolk Science Festival
title_zh: Suffolk Science Festival 公众科普
summary: Jennie joined IMS PhD students in Bury St Edmunds to explain neuroscience, digestion and insulin sensitivity.
summary_zh: Jennie 与 IMS 博士生赴 Bury St Edmunds，向儿童介绍神经科学、消化系统与胰岛素敏感性。
body: Jennie & IMS Public Engagement Associate Jane Sugars at the Suffolk Science Festival.

On Monday February 17th 2020, a team of PhD students from the Institute of Metabolic Science went to the Suffolk Science Festival in Bury St. Edmunds to teach local children about neurons, the anatomy of the gastrointestinal system and the importance of insulin sensitivity. Among the team was TVP lab PhD student Jennie Leggat.
Orla Woodward, Rachel Foreman, Jennie Leggat and Emily Miedzybrodska showing off their exhibits.
body_zh: 活动于 2020 年 2 月 17 日举行。团队通过展示与互动帮助当地学生理解人体科学，参与成员包括 Orla Woodward、Rachel Foreman、Jennie Leggat 和 Emily Miedzybrodska，并得到公众参与同事 Jane Sugars 的支持。

title: Saying goodbye to Jing Li
title_zh: 告别访问博士后 Jing Li
summary: The team thanked visiting postdoc Jing Li before her return to China.
summary_zh: 访问博士后 Jing Li 返回中国前，团队向她表达感谢与祝福。
body: Jing Li with TVP lab and her certificate!

At the end of December 2019, we very sadly had to say goodbye to visiting post-doc Dr. Jing Li as she returned to China to continue her research. To say goodbye, we had delicious Chinese food - made by Jing! - and gave Jing a certificate to commemorate her time with us. We'll miss you, Jing!
body_zh: 2019 年 12 月底，大家品尝了 Jing 亲手准备的中餐，并送上纪念证书，感谢她在 TVPlab 的工作与陪伴。祝愿她回国后一切顺利。

title: IMS Christmas Party
title_zh: IMS 圣诞聚会 2019
summary: TVPlab organised a European Christmas market-themed celebration for the Institute of Metabolic Science.
summary_zh: TVPlab 为 IMS 筹办了欧洲圣诞市集主题聚会。
body: This year, the TVP lab was in charge of organising the Institute of Metabolic Science departmental Christmas party!
Isabella, Rita, Guillaume, Agnes and Floris from TVP lab with Dr. Fazakerley at the IMS departmental Christmas party.

On Thursday December 12th 2019, members of the Institute of Metabolic Science stepped into a European Christmas Market in their very own social room! The TVP lab worked together to create an amazing event, with delicious food, fun games and cute market stalls - and maybe a few drinks! Special thanks go to Vanessa and Rita for their leadership in organisation of such a great event - the group who has to organise the Christmas party for 2020 have a lot to live up to!
body_zh: 12 月 12 日，研究所公共活动室变成充满节日气氛的市集，提供美食、游戏和小摊位。感谢 Vanessa 和 Rita 带领团队组织活动，也感谢所有参与筹备的成员。

title: TVP Lab Christmas Party
title_zh: TVPlab 圣诞午餐 2019
summary: Colleagues from IMS, Sanger and the Disease Model Core gathered for the lab’s Christmas lunch.
summary_zh: 来自 IMS、Sanger 和 Disease Model Core 的同事相聚，享用实验室圣诞午餐。
body: Members of the TVP Lab looking festive at the lab Christmas lunch.

On Wednesday December 11th 2019, all the laboratory members - including researchers and technicians from the IMS, Sanger and the Disease Model Core - got together at The MillWorks in Cambridge for a delicious lunch to celebrate the Christmas season! We then continued onto The Granta Pub and BrewDog for some festive drinks. A great time was had by all! Many thanks to Rita and Agnes for organising, and to Toni for contributing significantly to the cost of the meal. We already can't wait for next year!
body_zh: 2019 年 12 月 11 日，团队在剑桥 MillWorks 聚餐，随后继续节日交流。感谢 Rita 和 Agnes 组织活动，也感谢 Toni 对午餐费用的支持。

title: Metabolism in Action
title_zh: Metabolism in Action 会议
summary: TVPlab researchers joined the Copenhagen meeting, where Isabella Samuelson won a Best Poster Prize.
summary_zh: TVPlab 研究人员参加哥本哈根会议，Isabella Samuelson 获得最佳海报奖。
body: The team in Copenhagen.

The Metabolism in Action Conference was held in Copenhagen on the 27th to 31st of October 2019, and three researchers from the TVP lab went - Guillaume Bidault, Isabella Samuelson and Rita Dias - along with TVP lab alumna, Laura Mele. They had a great time, and Isabella even won the Best Poster Prize - great work!
Isabella with her poster prize.
body_zh: 会议于 2019 年 10 月 27 至 31 日举行。Guillaume Bidault、Isabella Samuelson、Rita Dias 和实验室往届成员 Laura Mele 共同参会，交流代谢研究并庆祝 Isabella 获奖。

title: When Patrice came to visit!
title_zh: Patrice 再次来访
summary: The team welcomed back Patrice, a visiting PhD researcher from Valencia.
summary_zh: 团队欢迎来自 Valencia 的博士研究人员 Patrice 再次来访。
body: Patrice and the TVP lab out for drinks.

On Saturday October 12th 2019, the TVP lab had a visitor! Patrice is PhD student from Valencia who came to the lab in 2018 to work with Dr. Bidault for a few months. He came back to visit, so the team went out  for dinner and drinks to welcome him back. Sadly he had to return to Valencia, but it was great to see him - good luck with the rest of your studies Patrice!
body_zh: Patrice 曾于 2018 年在 Guillaume Bidault 博士指导下进行短期研究。2019 年 10 月 12 日，他回到剑桥与同事聚餐交流。祝愿他后续学业顺利。

title: Chariots of Fire for the British Heart Foundation
title_zh: Chariots of Fire 为英国心脏基金会筹款
summary: Lab members and an alumna joined the charity relay in support of BHF-funded research.
summary_zh: 实验室成员与往届同事参加慈善接力赛，支持英国心脏基金会资助的研究。
body: Members of the TVP lab after their Chariots of Fire run.

On Sunday September 22nd 2019, researchers from the TVP lab took part in the Chariots of Fire race - organised by the Addenbrooke's Charitable Trust - to raise money for the British Heart Foundation. The BHF fund some of the research we do in the lab, so it is a cause that is close to our hearts. The researchers that took part were Guillaume Bidault, Rita Dias, Adrian Lin, Vanessa Pelligrinelli and Mark Campbell, along with TVP lab alumna Laura Mele. They all did an amazing job and we're very proud of them!
body_zh: 2019 年 9 月 22 日，Guillaume Bidault、Rita Dias、Adrian Lin、Vanessa Pellegrinelli、Mark Campbell 和 Laura Mele 参加了 Chariots of Fire 活动。团队感谢 BHF 对实验室研究的支持，并为参赛成员感到骄傲。

title: Danish Diabetes Academy Summer School
title_zh: 丹麦糖尿病学院暑期学校
summary: Rita Dias attended a summer school on diabetes and metabolism for PhD students in Denmark.
summary_zh: Rita Dias 参加丹麦面向博士生的糖尿病与代谢暑期学校。
body: Rita at the DDA Summer School

The Danish Diabetes Academy hosted a Summer School on Diabetes and Metabolism for PhD students in Ebberup, Denmark from August 26th-29th 2019, and our very own Rita Dias attended. She learned a lot from the school, and had a great time in the Danish sun - thank you DDA!
body_zh: Danish Diabetes Academy 于 2019 年 8 月 26 至 29 日在 Ebberup 举办课程。Rita 在学习和交流中收获良多，感谢组织方提供这一培训机会。

title: Filming for CBBC with Dr. Chris van Tulleken from Operation Ouch!
title_zh: CBBC《Operation Ouch!》走进实验室
summary: Chris van Tulleken visited the lab to film a programme explaining adipose tissue biology.
summary_zh: Chris van Tulleken 来到实验室，拍摄介绍脂肪组织生物学的科普节目。
body: CBBC's Dr. Chris van Tulleken with TVP lab Research Assistant Agnes Lukasik & PhD student Jennie Leggat.

On Friday July 12th 2019, Dr. Chris van Tulleken from CBBC's Operation Ouch! visited the lab to hear more about our research on adipose tissue. TVP lab PhD student Jennie Leggat talked to him about how adipose tissue expands as we get fat, and what can happen when our adipose tissue can't expand any further (see our research on the Adipose Tissue Expandability Hypothesis ). The episode aired on CBBC on Wednesday December 18th 2019 and can still be viewed on BBC iPlayer - find it here .
body_zh: 2019 年 7 月 12 日，CBBC《Operation Ouch!》主持人到访 TVPlab。Jennie Leggat 向他解释脂肪组织如何扩增，以及扩增能力达到极限后可能发生的问题。节目于同年 12 月 18 日在 CBBC 播出。

title: Cambridge and Nanjing Joint Workshop
title_zh: 剑桥—南京联合研讨会
summary: A joint workshop at IMS strengthened scientific links between Cambridge and Nanjing.
summary_zh: IMS 举办剑桥—南京联合研讨会，加强双方的科研联系。
body: Delegates of the Joint Workshop

On July 5th 2019, the Institute of Metabolic Science hosted a Joint Workshop with the Cambridge University Nanjing Cantre of Technology and Innovation, directed by Prof. Vidal-Puig, Prof. Shuai Chen and Dr. Rodriguez-Cuenca. Delegates from both Nanjing and Cambridge presented at the workshop. The event was a great success and has certainly strengthened the links between our two Institutions, allowing for more collaborations in the future.
Delegates of the Joint Workshop enjoying a post-workshop dinner at The Tamburlaine, Cambridge
body_zh: 2019 年 7 月 5 日，IMS 与剑桥大学南京科技创新中心开展联合活动，Toni Vidal-Puig、Shuai Chen 和 Sergio Rodriguez Cuenca 共同推动组织。双方代表分享研究，并在会后继续交流，为后续合作奠定基础。

title: European Atherosclerosis Society Symposium
title_zh: 欧洲动脉粥样硬化学会高级课程
summary: TVPlab helped deliver practical training in cardiometabolic phenotyping in animal models.
summary_zh: TVPlab 参与动物模型心脏代谢表型分析的高级培训课程。
body: Delegates of the EAS Advanced Course 2019

On July 2nd-4th 2019, the University of Cambridge hosted the European Atherosclerosis Society Advanced Course in Cardiometabolic Phenotyping in Animal Models. The TVP Lab was heavily involved in this course, with a number of Research Associates teaching and providing practical demonstrations. It was an excellent event that was enjoyed by all, with 95% of participants rating the both the Course Usefulness and Scientific Content as above average or excellent. Well done to the team!
body_zh: 2019 年 7 月 2 至 4 日，剑桥大学举办 European Atherosclerosis Society 高级课程。多位 TVPlab 研究人员授课并进行实验示范；原文记录，95% 的参与者认为课程实用性与科学内容达到高于平均或优秀水平。

title: London to Brighton cycle for the British Heart Foundation
title_zh: 伦敦至布莱顿慈善骑行
summary: Jennie and fellow researchers completed a 60-mile ride, with their five-person team raising £1,115 for BHF.
summary_zh: Jennie 与科研同伴完成 60 英里骑行，五人团队为英国心脏基金会筹得 1,115 英镑。
body: TVP lab PhD student Jennie Leggat with fellow BHF-funded PhD students Robyn Macrae and Matt Worssam.

On Sunday June 16th 2019, TVP lab PhD student Jennie Leggat cycled the 60 miles from Clapham Common in London to Brighton Beach to raise money for the British Heart Foundation. The BHF generously funds a lot of research that takes place in the TVP lab, as well as funding Jennie's PhD. In total, the team of 5 raised £1115 for lifesaving cardiovascular research - well done!
body_zh: 2019 年 6 月 16 日，他们从伦敦 Clapham Common 骑行至 Brighton Beach。BHF 资助了 Jennie 的博士研究及 TVPlab 的部分科研工作，团队借此支持心血管研究。

title: Cambridge Science Festival
title_zh: 剑桥科学节 2019
summary: Rita joined IMS-MRL PhD students to demonstrate insulin’s role in glucose regulation.
summary_zh: Rita 与 IMS-MRL 博士生共同展示胰岛素在血糖调节中的作用。
body: Rita and other PhD students running the IMS-MRL stall at the Science Festival

The Cambridge Science Festival ran this year from the 11th to the 24th of March 2019. The IMS-MRL contributed to the festival as usual with a stall run by PhD students from the Institute, including TVP Lab PhD student Rita Dias. This years stall was designed by the students and demonstrated the importance of insulin in glucose regulation to the wider public. Well done students!
body_zh: 剑桥科学节于 2019 年 3 月 11 至 24 日举办。学生们设计并运营互动展台，让公众以直观方式了解代谢科学。

title: Vanessa's baby shower!
title_zh: Vanessa 的迎婴聚会
summary: The team gathered to wish Vanessa well as she began maternity leave.
summary_zh: Vanessa 开始产假前，团队相聚为她送上祝福。
body: TVP lab celebrating in the IMS Social Room

At the end of November 2018, our Research Associate Vanessa began her maternity leave, so we had a baby shower to say goodbye and wish her luck in her new job as a mother! Baby Leonardo was born happy and health on December 1st 2018 - congratulations to Vanessa and Alessandro!
body_zh: 2018 年 11 月底，大家在 IMS 公共活动室举办迎婴聚会。原文随后分享了宝宝 Leonardo 于 12 月 1 日出生的喜讯，祝贺 Vanessa 和 Alessandro。

title: Night out at the Cambridge Graduate Orchestra
title_zh: 剑桥研究生管弦乐团之夜
summary: Lab colleagues supported a concert combining music, physiology and fundraising for BHF.
summary_zh: 实验室同事参加融合音乐、生理学与慈善筹款的音乐会，支持英国心脏基金会。
body: Flyer for the Cambridge Graduate Orchestra performance in aid of the British Heart Foundation

As part of the Cambridge Science Festival this year, the Cambridge Graduate Orchestra teamed up with Dr. Andrew Murray to put on a performance of beautiful music interspersed with fascinating science and anecdotes from Dr. Murray's time on Xtreme Everest researching human physiology at the extremes. One of the TVP lab's Research Associates, Vanessa Pelligrinelli, is part of the Graduate Orchestra so played on the night, and did a great job! A number of the lab went along to support the event, which was in aid of the British Heart Foundation.
body_zh: 剑桥科学节期间，研究生管弦乐团与 Andrew Murray 博士合作，将音乐演奏与他在 Xtreme Everest 研究极端环境人体生理学的经历相结合。Vanessa Pellegrinelli 作为乐团成员参与演出，实验室同事到场支持。

title: 14th Key Symposium on Metabolic Complications of Obesity
title_zh: 第十四届 Key Symposium：肥胖的代谢并发症
summary: TVPlab contributed talks and posters to the Cambridge symposium on metabolic complications of obesity.
summary_zh: TVPlab 在剑桥举办的肥胖代谢并发症研讨会上分享报告与海报。
body: TVP Lab at the Key Symposium at St Catharine's College, Cambridge.

The 14th Key Symposium on Metabolic Complications of Obesity was held this year at St. Catharine's College, Cambridge on 20th-22nd September 2017. Its organisation was a collaborative effort between the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences, the Journal of Internal Medicine and the Institute of Metabolic Science.  The TVP lab attended the symposium, with some members delivering presentations and posters, and Prof. Vidal-Puig acting as JIM Guest Editor for this occasion.
Delegates of the 14th Key Symposium.
body_zh: 会议于 2017 年 9 月 20 至 22 日在 St Catharine’s College 举行，由瑞典皇家科学院、Journal of Internal Medicine 和 IMS 合作组织。Toni 担任该期刊相关专题的客座编辑。
